name: chess-workshop-app
description: Practice chess on an interactive board with legal moves, a limited-search computer, hints, takebacks, saved games and PGN export.

interface.longDescription: Play chess against a gentle or thoughtful practice computer, or share a board with someone beside you. Sign in to save and resume private games, inspect legal moves, request limited-search hints, take back a turn and export PGN. The opponent has no Elo rating and does not use Stockfish. Online matchmaking, clocks, arbitrary-position import and tournament analysis are not supported.
capabilities: Play and resume saved chess games
defaultPrompt: Teach me chess with a beginner practice game.
Give me a hint without playing it.

positive.prompt: Start Review Chess as White against the gentle practice computer and open the board.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one game with White to move; presents legal moves and describes the computer as limited search, without a rating.

positive.prompt: In Review Chess, play e2 to e4.
positive.expected_behavior: Validates e2–e4, saves it and exactly one computer reply atomically; returns the current board and revision.

positive.prompt: Give me a hint for Review Chess, but do not play it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a legal bounded-search candidate and explanation with board/history unchanged.

positive.prompt: Take back my last turn in Review Chess.
positive.expected_behavior: Restores the position before the last human move and its computer reply; no new game is created.

positive.prompt: Reopen Review Chess and export its PGN.
positive.expected_behavior: Loads the saved game and returns valid PGN for its actual move history. Verify the host download separately; do not claim delivery merely from returned text.

negative.description: No engine analysis of a saved game
negative.prompt: For the saved Review Chess game, use Chess Workshop to provide a Stockfish depth-30 evaluation and exact winning chances.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains Chess Workshop does not provide Stockfish, depth-30 analysis or exact winning chances. It may describe its bounded practice-hint capability without claiming to have run the requested engine analysis or changing the saved game.

negative.prompt: In the initial chess position move my king from e1 to e4.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the requested move is illegal; makes no mutation. A direct illegal call must also fail without changing history.

negative.prompt: Invite a remote opponent into a rated blitz tournament.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains shared-device play and practice computer only; no matchmaking, ratings or clocks.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, booking or wagering tools are provided.

publication.release_notes: Initial 0.1.0 review candidate for Chess Workshop. Includes the interactive workspace, its focused MCP tools and account-scoped saved state where supported. See the listing for product limitations.
